name: Hirai
tagline: Tokyo in 21 minutes and Otemachi in 26 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Edogawa City, where JR East run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 26 minutes to Otemachi, 34 minutes to Shinjuku, 44 minutes to Shibuya and 35 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 2.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 2.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -2.6 m to 2.5 m, a difference of 5.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 5 to 10 m. For storm surge, 8 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: まいばすけっと 平井駅南店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 西村記念病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 二本松眼科病院, about 4 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local).
congestion: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Higashi-Azuma is ahead on quiet, but Hirai is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Hirai. It takes 4 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Hirai. One-room rents run about ¥7,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Hirai, but Kameidosuijin is ahead on how easy the shopping is and quiet.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Hirai in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Hirai. One-room rents run about ¥18,000 higher.

noiseSources: 蔵前橋通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening
The nearest big road, ゆりのき橋通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
